title: onSuccessUpdateOriginal skips immutable-field validation
description: In handle_email_copy (email.rs:1264-1294), patches from onSuccessUpdateOriginal are applied to the source email via backend.update_object without calling find_immutable_patch_key. A client can set immutable Email fields (from, to, messageId, blobId, etc.) on the original email by including them in onSuccessUpdateOriginal — bypassing the explicit check that handle_email_set performs for every normal patch. The fix is to call find_immutable_patch_key(patch) before calling update_object in the onSuccessUpdateOriginal loop, and reject with invalidProperties if any immutable field is touched.
